notifications.emptyHint: We'll let you know when something needs you.

kinds.approval_waiting: {employee} drafted a reply to {contact} that needs your approval
kinds.usage_threshold: You've used {percent}% of your {meter} this month

problems.quality_low: Message quality is low, so sending is limited
problems.token_expired: Access expired, so bookings are not syncing
problems.dns_unverified: DNS records are not verified yet

statusHint.on: Your AI employee replies to customers within the limits you set. Drafts that need approval wait in Approvals.
statusHint.suggest_only: Your AI employee drafts replies, and people on your team send them.
statusHint.off: The AI is switched off. Your team handles every conversation.
statusHint.paused: All AI activity is paused. Nothing is sent by the AI until you resume.
statusHint.manual: You're running without an AI employee. Everything works by hand, and you can add one any time.

ai.askToPause: Only someone with the {role} role can pause the AI.
ai.whyTitle: Why the AI answered this way

setup.title: Finish setting up
setup.body: Each step gets you closer to your first lead handled automatically.
setup.finishBody: Pick up where you left off. Everything you entered is saved.

trial.title: Your trial ends in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
trial.body: Choose a plan to keep your inbox, bookings and AI running without a break.

trial_expired.title: Your trial has ended
trial_expired.body: Your data is safe and you can still read and export it. Choose a plan to start replying and booking again.

past_due.title: Your last payment didn't go through
past_due.body: Update your payment method within {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} to avoid marketing sends being paused. Live conversations are not affected.

suspended.title: Your account is suspended
suspended.body: Sending and the AI are paused while we review your account. You can still read and export your data. Contact support to resolve this.

paused.title: Your account is paused
paused.body: Everything is read-only and billing is paused until you resume.

cancelled.title: Your plan is cancelled
cancelled.body: You have full access until the end of this billing period, then 30 days of read-only access.

connection_broken.title: {connection}: {problem}
connection_broken.body: Fix it to keep messages and bookings flowing.

template_rejected.title: WhatsApp rejected your template {template}
template_rejected.body: Messages that use it outside the 24-hour window can't be sent. Edit and resubmit it.

compliance_blocking.title: A compliance step is blocking go-live
compliance_blocking.body: AI disclosure wording is missing for one of your languages, so the AI can't message customers yet.

ai_paused.title: All AI activity is paused
ai_paused.body: Your team is handling every conversation. Nothing is sent by the AI until you resume.

error.title: We couldn't load this
error.body: Something went wrong on our side. Your data is safe. Please try again.

noPermission.title: You don't have access to this
noPermission.body: Ask someone with the {role} role to do this, or to change your access.
noPermission.requested: Request sent. We'll let you know when it's approved.

offline.body: You're offline. Changes will be saved when you reconnect.

stale.body: This page changed since you opened it.

notFound.title: We can't find that page
notFound.body: It may have moved. Use the menu or search to find what you need.

login.title: Sign in to {brand}
login.body: This is a demo with sample data. Use the wrench button to switch business, role or language.
login.note: Sign-up, password sign-in and account recovery arrive in the next build step.

modules.placeholderBody: This screen is built in step {slice}. The navigation, permissions and data behind it are already live.

noAi.title: Approvals appear when you add an AI employee
noAi.body: You're running in manual mode. Everything works by hand, and the AI can be added any time without redoing setup.

dev.statesIntro: Every state pattern and base component, wired to the mock API. Use the wrench button to change role, network, language and theme.
dev.statesCard: Empty, loading, error, no-permission, offline and stale states, status chips, AI language and form controls.
dev.scenariosCard: Switch between seeded businesses: salon in Lagos, clinic in Abuja, barber in London and more.

states.liveBody: A real request to the mock API. Switch the outcome to see each required state.
states.forbiddenHint: This request needs permission to export contacts. Owners and admins see data; switch to Manager, Staff or Read-only in the toolbar to see the no-permission state.
states.emptyBody: Contacts appear here when customers message you, book or fill a form. You can also add them yourself.
states.controlsBody: Inputs follow the location's country, currency, time zone and week start.
states.deleteTitle: Delete {count, plural, one {# contact} other {# contacts}}?
states.deleteBody: {count, plural, one {This contact and their conversation history} other {These # contacts and their conversation history}} will be permanently deleted. This can't be undone.
states.deleteConfirm: Delete {count, plural, one {# contact} other {# contacts}}
states.deleted: {count, plural, one {# contact deleted} other {# contacts deleted}}
states.drawerBody: Drawers slide in from the end side and mirror in right-to-left languages.
states.tooltip: Tooltips explain without cluttering the screen.
states.offlineBody: Shown at the top of the app when the network drops. Set the network to Offline in the toolbar to try it.
states.staleBody: Shown when another tab or teammate changes data. Open this app in two tabs and change the account state in one.
states.permissionBody: You're viewing as {role}. Controls you could unlock are disabled with the reason; controls you can never use are hidden.
states.permissionHint: Invite a teammate is hidden for roles that can't manage the team.
states.chipsBody: The same state always looks the same, with an icon so color is never the only signal.
states.aiBody: Anything the AI wrote or did is marked in violet, with its confidence.
states.sampleDraft: Hi Chioma! Knotless braids, medium length, are ₦35,000 and take about 5 hours. I can book you for Saturday at 10am or 1pm. Which works better?

copy.label: Copy {label}
copy.failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
